descriptions.text: Asojano - Orisha. Level 130 City Boss. This is a non-corporeal spirit. Also known as the Lord of Smallpox, Asojano is one of the most respected and feared of the Orishas, a former god made flesh upon the rise of the Ascendency. As the worshippers of these gods grew more and more extinct, their temples crumbled, and the power of these former deities waned. […] One day, not so long ago, Asojano found himself here in this small town, visiting the world he once helped rule. There was no malice to his actions. He came just so he could look upon what he once had and what he had lost. Still, power lingers, even in the most forgotten of shells. Asojano is disease incarnate. He kills, and he heals. He is life, and he is death. He also wears a reed hat that makes it difficult to see where he's going, so he bumps into stuff a lot.

recap.text: Asojano, the Lord of Smallpox, asks Paz to repair his shrine to free the town spirits. Carl flags Skylar Spinach and Bomo repairs Yemaya's shrine while Donut and Mongo take Asojano apart. Carl flags Asojano and leaves with slugpox. As a totem, Asojano kills bomber pigs with a fat wand. He fuses with Uzi Jesus and Skylar Spinach to become Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang before a demon crab pulls him into Sheol.

beats.headline: A city boss attaches himself to the party
beats.text: I have him at level 130 and non-corporeal, and he is now standing in a crawler party's safe room as though that were a normal thing for a city boss to do. There is a request attached to the company: repair his shrine and the spirits held in this town go free. He asks Paz specifically, which tells you he has read the party's paperwork rather more carefully than the party has.
beats.gist: Asojano, the non-corporeal level 130 city boss, asks Paz to repair his shrine to free spirits.

beats.headline: The ritual at the shrine
beats.text: They reach the temple intact. Carl flags a ghommid splitter by the name of Skylar Spinach on the way, which I enjoyed. Asojano begins his ritual, and at that exact moment Ogun hands his own worshippers a quest of his own: one shrine may be repaired, and he would like it to be his. Paz and Anton read it together. Carl, Donut and Ines start working out how one fights a city boss inside his own temple.
beats.gist: Carl flags Skylar Spinach, a ghommid splitter, as they reach the temple intact.

beats.headline: Flagged a heartbeat before he falls
beats.text: Deities arrive from every direction, each with a shrine to argue for. Carl sends Bomo to repair Yemaya's, which settles the argument. Donut and Mongo take Asojano apart, and Carl flags him a heartbeat before he goes, so what remains of the Lord of Smallpox is a card in a crawler's deck. The ghommid settlement is liberated. Carl leaves with slugpox, which is very much the sort of souvenir this floor hands out.
beats.gist: Deities argue over shrines until Bomo repairs Yemaya's; Donut and Mongo dismantle Asojano for Carl's deck.

beats.headline: He tries it once
beats.text: Practice record: the first thing Subject does as a totem is attempt a nasty debuff on his own deckmaster, blocked by the arena's safeties. He has not tried it again. Shouted at, he snaps to attention and does as told, and he fights with enthusiasm once he starts: one shake of his fat wand and a whole squad of bomber pigs falls out of the sky boiling with sores, dead before landing. That was the first kill anyone other than Shi Maria managed while she was on the field.
beats.gist: Asojano attempts a debuff on his deckmaster, but arena safeties block it.

beats.headline: Half of Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang
beats.text: The card gets played. Asojano and Uzi Jesus combine into a single totem, Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang, which is either the best or the worst thing to happen to a former god of disease. I have decided not to rule on which.
beats.gist: A card combines Asojano and Uzi Jesus into a single totem called Lazarus-A-Bang-Bang.

beats.headline: Lazarus is pulled under
beats.text: Lazarus, the card built from Asojano and Uzi Jesus, had been fused with Skylar Spinach by a Golden Combo and made permanent with Glow Up, Tserendolgor's other consumable card, and was a candidate for the single card Princess Donut may carry down. High in the burning building he trembles with rage at the sight of Amayon, and Crawler Carl stops his RPG. He complains that they are all pansies. Then a demon crab comes through a wall, grabs him, and both vanish into Sheol. Totem Eliminated.
beats.gist: A demon crab pulls Asojano into Sheol, eliminating the totem.
